summary: JenkinsPipelineUtils' containerTemplates gains aac_tools(name) — the floating python entry's shape with image registry:5000/aac-tools, no runAsUser or entrypoint override (a4d5ba1 on phase/014-P1). The repo has no gate and this environment has no Groovy toolchain, so the entry is unexercised until the operator's first AaC/ArgoCDDeploy build; P2's text now names the call.
